name: PT Prima Cakrawala Abadi Tbk
summary: PT Prima Cakrawala Abadi Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the processing and distribution of fishery products in Indonesia. It offers crabs, meat, frozen and fresh fish, preserves crustaceans, and other seafoods. The company is also involved in wholesale and retail trade, transportation, warehousing, and fisheries. PT Prima Cakrawala Abadi Tbk was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Semarang, Indonesia.
